note: One row per pull request number this library cites. The forge is outside this tree, so a number's disposition cannot be checked from a clone; this file is the dated snapshot that makes the check offline, and `node skills/forge-citations.mjs --refresh` prints the commands that re-take it. See the methodology section on what a pull request citation owes.
